_schema: One line per (RMH, id, source) pair. RMH has two codebook elements; per-element rows (mentions, reacting_to, want, rejects, match_level, quote_want, quote_page, note, derived code_minority/code_majority) are under elements. Top-level wants/rejects join both elements; code is a summary string of the derived codes (0-4) per element and map; quote/page are from RMH-A when it has a stance, else RMH-B. RMH-B is coded not mentioned where Banff-Jasper is only listed as one of the three interim ridings (as the codebook does for EBC-2025-2-0409). Records over 9,000 characters were read in keyword windows (place names of the region, +/-700 characters) plus the opening, and in full where the record is core to RMH.
